mapper.update: UPDATE agent_expense_risk_run SET status=#{status},version=#{version},state_json=#{stateJson},active_report_id=#{reportId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status=#{previous} AND context_json=#{contextJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_expense_risk_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM agent_expense_risk_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id, CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN q.task_id ELSE NULL END AS task_id FROM agent_expense_risk_run q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=q.round_no WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT #{BATCH_SIZE}

SELECT id,status,version,created_at FROM agent_expense_risk_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{reportId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_expense_risk_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{reportId} AND round_no=#{roundNo}
SELECT * FROM agent_expense_risk_document WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{id} ORDER BY ordinal
